title: Technician: role permissions match the expected set
preconds: 1. A user is assigned the Technician role.
steps:
1. Open the Technician role's Permission Summary (eye icon on the Roles list).
  2. Check the add/edit/delete areas, the Page Access toggles, the Work orders sub-settings, the View mode and the Cross-Cutting Toggles.
  3. Optionally log in as the user and spot-check a few of the role's typical tasks.
expected: The Technician permissions match the expected set: Work orders View only; Work order lines Create & Edit (View inherited); Schedule View only; Customers View only; Part sales/Catalog/Vendor/Invoicing off; Timesheets off; Reports off; Customer portal off; Parts Department off; Settings off; See Financial Data off; Pick parts on; View mode Tech view.
